question: Prithviraj Chauhan and Muhammad Ghori fought the battle of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** ​__Tarain__**.

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• There were **two battles between Muhammad Ghori and Prithviraj Chauhan **in the plain of Tarain.

 
 
• **First War (1191 AD) -**

 
 
• Prithviraj Chauhan was victorious in this war.
 
 
 
• **Second Battle of Tarain (1192 AD) -**
 
 
• In this war, Prithviraj Chauhan was badly defeated by **Muhammad Ghori.**​
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Battle of Chanderi (29 January 1528 AD) -**

 
 
• This war was fought between the **Mughals and the Rajputs.**
 
• In this war, the **Mughal army was led by Babur** and the **Rajput army was led by Medini Rai.​**
 
 
 
• **Battle of Talikote (23 January 1565 AD) -**
 
 
• This war was fought between the** Deccan Sultanates and the Vijayanagara Empire.**
 
• The Vijayanagara Empire had to** face defeat in this war**.
 
• This war was the **fall of the last Hindu kingdom **of South India.​
 
 
 
• **Battle of Chausa (26 June 1539) -**
 
 
• It was fought near **Chausa village** in **the Buxar district** of the modern Bihar state.
 
• This war was a war in India between the **Mughal Emperor Humayun and Sher Shah Suri**, the founder of the Suri Empire.
 
• Sher Shah Suri was victorious in this and Humayun fled from the battlefield to save his life.
